disclaimer: Demonstration criteria only. Real scheme conditions are set by the implementing department and vary by scheme and state.

rules.label: Applicant age between 18 and 70
rules.failMessage: The applicant's age is outside the 18–70 range used by this demo scheme.
rules.suggestion: If another adult family member is the cultivator, they may be able to apply.

rules.label: Cultivated land of 5 acres or less
rules.failMessage: Cultivated land is above the 5-acre limit for this demo small-farmer scheme.
rules.suggestion: Larger farms may be better served by the bank loan route.

rules.label: Farm income of ₹2,50,000 a year or less
rules.failMessage: Yearly farm income is above the ₹2,50,000 limit for this demo scheme.
rules.suggestion: Consider the bank loan route, which assesses repayment capacity instead of an income ceiling.

rules.label: Support requested of ₹1,00,000 or less
rules.failMessage: The support amount requested is above the ₹1,00,000 demo limit.
rules.suggestion: Reduce the requested amount to ₹1,00,000 or less and resubmit.

rules.label: Bank account in the applicant's name
rules.failMessage: A bank account in the applicant's name is needed to receive support.
rules.suggestion: Open a basic savings account at any bank branch and update the application.

rules.label: No unmet conditions on an earlier scheme
rules.failMessage: An earlier scheme's conditions were not met.
rules.suggestion: Ask the agriculture office how to clear the earlier case before reapplying.
